subject: Game Theory
title: Genetic Enhancement Race
description: Learn Genetic Enhancement Race in one minute.

hook.text: If one country allows genetic enhancement, parents elsewhere face pressure: enhance your kids or they fall behind.

buildup.text: Genetic enhancement creates an arms race: nobody wants it, but nobody can afford to opt out if others start.

discovery.text: Like doping in sports, the equilibrium shifts: if cheating is common, clean competition becomes impossible.

twist.text: Unlike sports doping, genetic changes are permanent and heritable. The stakes are generations, not one race.

climax.text: International coordination is the only solution: a ban that all countries enforce, like bioweapons treaties.

punchline.text: When enhancement starts, opting out isn't an option.

quiz.question: Why is genetic enhancement an arms race?
options: If others enhance, opting out means falling behind
